product.olivetti-snx-140.summary: The entry Systema that moved from Pentium 66 to 75 under the same name.
product.olivetti-snx-140.history: Olivetti offered the SNX 140 in 1994 as a business network server. According to its guide, the 75 MHz configuration replaced the 66 MHz version under the same name in September 1995.
product.olivetti-snx-140.architecture: The CPU speed identifies two different board designs. Olivetti documents Intel Mercury for 66 MHz and Intel Neptune for 75 MHz.
product.olivetti-snx-140.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-140.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
